identity_description: Nonblank native string aliasName; native arrival order is retained.
limitations: Fixed qualified query context GUAPW3SG, timezone GMT+08, currentArea 3; these are accepted scope values, not a claim of backend mandatory defaults.
Native GET query carries accountFilterConfigQuery as a JSON string. Qualified widths are5000 and1000, not measured maxima. SDK fallback restarts at offset0.
Both success markers and equal native inner/outer counts are required. Duplicates, gaps and conflicting identities cannot prove complete coverage.
Local filters match exact values; commas and * are literal. Native row tntInstId may be absent or empty without fabrication.
No Get, latest-version selection, related account lookup or inferred blacklist enforcement.
